svg.title: Hoffman–Martín–White three-ended shrinkers: connected topology model
svg.desc: Original genus-six schematic: three sheets joined by eight alternating open necks. Full view and cutaway. Three outer rims truncate the ends. Separate plan shows four horizontal lines and alternating neck sites. No shrinker equation has been solved.

g.text: Hoffman–Martín–White: three ends, one connected surface
Topology model with g = 3 · genus 2g = 6 · eight alternating necks
Three ends joined through open necks
Necks alternate between the two gaps
Four upper + four lower connections give model genus six.
The horizontal trace consists of g + 1 equally spaced lines.
Each exterior sheet continues to an end; all rims are artificial.
Large-genus limit: one plane with multiplicity three.
SCHEMATIC · not a computed shrinker · three-ended existence is proved only for sufficiently large g
